name: subagents
description: Model-tiered Claude Code subagents: haiku for mechanical execution, opus for judgment-heavy development, fable for read-only review

interface.shortDescription: Three model-tiered Claude Code subagents to delegate work by cost and judgment required
interface.longDescription: Claude Code subagent definitions loaded from the bundle's agents/ directory: haiku-task runs simple, explicitly scoped mechanical work at low cost; opus-dev implements bounded changes, reviews, and diagnoses bugs where judgment matters; fable-review is a read-only, highest-quality reviewer for bug hunting, plan review, and verifying cheaper agents' output. Each agent returns conclusions and validation results rather than a step-by-step log. The bundle ships no skills; other harnesses load it as an empty plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use haiku-task to apply this rename across the listed files.
Delegate this bounded change to opus-dev and report the test results.
Have fable-review hunt for bugs in this diff.
